name: Asius
desc: Asius is an Adret NPC. The player is able to take back owed money for [The Summer Company](faction:the_summer_company) in [Trig's](entity:trig) Quest.
additional_info:
-   They wear the Experienced Adventurer Outfit.
-   If accidentally choosing, "I'll see what I can do.," the player is able to speak with Asius again to receive the owed money.
